flashcard_questions.q: What happens during the pre-production phase of a media project?
flashcard_questions.a: Planning and design work carried out before any content is created.

flashcard_questions.q: What happens during the post-production phase?
flashcard_questions.a: The content is edited and refined ready for distribution.

flashcard_questions.q: Which stage comes after post-production in getting a product to audiences?
Which creative role works only in the pre-production phase?
Which creative role works only during the production phase?
Which creative role produces original drawings, comic art and concept art?
Which creative role designs the visual layout and user experience of websites?
Which technical role edits and mixes audio tracks after recording?
Which technical role operates sound recording equipment during filming?
Which technical role turns a web designer's visual plans into a working site?
Which technical role writes the code that makes digital games function?
Which phase is when a video editor assembles recorded footage?
Why might one person perform more than one role on a project?
flashcard_questions.a: Because of the size and scale of the project.

notes: 13 cards: 8 role-to-description, 3 phase cards, 1 role-to-phase, 1 causal. Role fronts each name one distinguishing duty so no two fronts share an answer (sound editor vs audio technician, web designer vs web developer).
